headline: Google warns of a December core update before it starts
dek: Google's November 2026 core update finished rolling out at 9:03 am ET on November 24, after 14 days. The same morning, Google posted that a December 2026 core update is coming, with no start date. Google says it will also improve personalized results for people who have personalization turned on, and a spokesperson told Search Engine Roundtable the rollout is not imminent.
why: Google has said for years that it does not preannounce core updates, and it ties this notice to UK fair ranking rules. Two broad updates this close together make it hard to tell which one moved your traffic.
doThis: Export your Search Console clicks by page for November 10 to 24 this week and save the file. When December's update starts, you will have a clean before snapshot to compare against.
